# Zoé — components & tools (generated)

## <z-element> (core)
The living base: carries interaction states as :state() and emits z-state.
Attributes: current (boolean), loading (boolean), busy (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success

## <z-checkbox> (components)
A checkbox — inherits all z-element states, marker + label anatomy, painted by the skin.
Attributes: current (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success

## <z-button> (components)
A button — inherits all z-element states, skinnable by themes.
Attributes: disabled (boolean), loading (boolean), busy (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success
